title: Ralph Mote Larsson says he knows nothing about UFOs and would publicize it if he did

tellings.quote: guy Ralph Moat Lararsson who we spoke about. I think you know him and um you know I interviewed you and I interview a bunch of people who I respect from government circles and they know nothing about the UFO stuff

plain: Michels says that a man from government circles named Ralph Moat Lararsson, whom he had discussed before, knows nothing about UFOs, and neither do many of the respected officials he has interviewed. He tells this himself, to a former director of the NSA, as a puzzle: if well-placed people know nothing, either there is nothing or it is hidden very deep.
